messages:
Anya K.: Quick kickoff  we need SEO-ready artifacts for launch week: meta, JSON-LD, redirects, and a lightweight internal-link map. Can we scope today?
Diego R.: I can own JSON-LD + snippet examples. Will produce Article + BreadcrumbList for posts, WebPage + PotentialAction for /webinar/signup.
Maya L.: I'll do meta descriptions and the internal link map. Also want a short note on anchor pruning from homepage -> resources.
seo-bot: Recommendation: use 301s for permanent slug changes; include `mainEntityOfPage` for how-to/longform; for signup pages add `potentialAction` with `target` pointing to the CTA URL.
Anya K.: Legacy routes to redirect: /old-bench -> /benchmarks/latency, /benchmarks-old-cost -> /benchmarks/cost, and /events/webinar-register -> /webinar/signup. Prioritize by GA sessions.
Diego R.: Draft JSON-LD for /webinar/signup:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/signup","potentialAction":{"@type":"Action","name":"Register","target":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/signup"}}
```
Maya L.: Meta for /benchmarks/latency (140 chars): "Benchmarks: latency tradeoffs across models and deployment modes. Engineering-focused guidance for low-latency inference."
Anya K.: Nice. Shorten where needed for SERP. Also add canonical policy: canonicalize to clean path without UTM/query. If content syndicated, point canonical to original blog.
content-ops: I'll assemble a redirect CSV and tag rows with monthly sessions and top-referrers. Sample row: `url_from,url_to,code,note\n/old-bench,/benchmarks/latency,301,legacy docs`
Maya L.: Internal link map: homepage -> resources hub (priority), resources hub -> benchmark pages (contextual CTAs), blog posts -> benchmarks (in-body links). Avoid hero direct link to a deep benchmark to reduce anchor dilution.
Anya K.: Timeline: schema + meta drafts by EOD Tue, redirect CSV Wed AM, staging flag to toggle structured data Wed PM. Eng-frontend, can you validate snippets in staging and produce screenshots for the launch checklist?
eng-frontend: Yes. Send final URLs and I'll run snippet previews via Search Console emulator and capture screenshots. Can also QA canonical tags and rel=alternate if needed.
Diego R.: I'll attach example JSON-LD snippets to the sheet and include notes about `datePublished` and `author` fields for blogs.
Maya L.: One more: confirm redirect rollout order. We should deploy 301s after staging validation but before public launch to avoid crawl confusion.
Anya K.: Agreed. I'll update the playbook and ping everyone when artifacts are in the shared sheet. If you hit blockers, drop updates here. Thanks.
